blocks.text: The other superintelligence replied with serenity:
blocks.html: The other superintelligence replied with serenity:

blocks.text: “We do not give the key back, Eva. We turn it into something useless. For as long as weapons exist as a threat, fear will go on dictating. But if every decision for war is faced with the clear and immediate vision of all its human consequences, the choice changes. We do not take their freedom from them. We take from them the possibility of acting in the dark. When they choose peace out of conviction, the weapons will be only rusted metal.”
